description: This file defines the QrSegment class for encoding segments of data into QR codes, including static factory methods for creating segments in different modes (numeric, alphanumeric, byte, ECI), and internal logic for handling QR code data segments.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a data segment for QR code encoding, including modes, data, and factory methods for creating segments in various modes.

classes.name: QrSegment.Mode
classes.description: Enumeration of QR code segment modes, with methods to determine character count bits based on version.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a byte mode segment from binary data.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a numeric mode segment from a string of digits.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates an alphanumeric mode segment from a string with allowed characters.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Creates a list of segments from any Unicode string, choosing encoding mode automatically.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates an ECI mode segment with a specified assignment value.
